completeness.why: Every bulk action takes its category selection (income rule plus hidden/hidden-group rule) from isMonthFillTarget/getMonthFillCategories, choosing only an explicit scope ('all' for setZero, 'not-hidden' for copyPreviousMonth's NULL-group behaviour, 'visible' for the averages); the per-site SQL filters and income checks are gone, and both sign inversions go through spendingToBudgetAmount.

interface.why: A single scope parameter carries exactly the real variation and names the preserved inconsistencies (setZero writes hidden, missing group kept vs skipped) with a comment, and the sign rule is its own small function; the 'visible' vs 'not-hidden' names are close and only distinguishable via the comment.

disguised_duplication.where: The duplicated income/hidden checks and the two sign inversions are removed and routed through the new shared functions rather than reshaped.
